pages.title: OP-18 The Dominance of God (神の支配) — Release Date, Pack Price and Card Count
pages.description: OP-18 神の支配 releases November 21, 2026 in Japan and November 20, 2026 in English. Official pack price, pack contents and card-type count, with the fields that are still open before a sealed-box valuation.
pages.headline: OP-18 “神の支配” / “The Dominance of God”: confirmed release dates and official product facts
pages.introHtml: Bandai published the OP-18 product pages on both its Japanese and English sites. The eighteenth main booster, 神の支配 / The Dominance of God, releases on November 21, 2026 in Japan and November 20, 2026 in English — across the 22 sets tracked here, the first English date to land ahead of its Japanese one. The set is themed on Water Seven and the Holy Knights of God, and contains 127+1 card types. What is still missing is the full card list, the rarity breakdown and any completed sale, so this page records the confirmed specification and leaves the valuation fields open.

pages.sourceHtml: Sources read September 28, 2026: Bandai's Japanese OP-18 product page and Bandai's English OP-18 product page. The 24-pack box figure comes from the Amazon.co.jp listing linked from our Amazon Japan raffle page and is labelled as a retailer source because Bandai's own pages do not state a box configuration.

sections.heading: What is confirmed and what is still open
paragraphsHtml: Confirmed on Bandai's own pages: the set code OP-18, both titles (神の支配 and The Dominance of God), the Japanese release date of November 21, 2026, the English release date of November 20, 2026, ¥240 and USD $4.99 per pack, six cards per Japanese pack, 127+1 card types, and the Water Seven / Holy Knights of God theme with Saint Gunko and Saint Shamrock debuting.

Still open: the full card list, the rarity and parallel breakdown, the Japanese display specification, and any completed sale. The 24-pack box count comes from a retailer listing rather than Bandai, so it is labelled that way rather than treated as official.

The Japanese gap from OP-17 (August 22, 2026) to OP-18 is 91 days — the interval that appears in 10 of the 17 Japanese main-set gaps recorded on our set list and release dates page. That is a record of what has already happened, not a method used to produce this date; the date above comes from Bandai.

sections.heading: How the Amazon Japan invite works for OP-18
paragraphsHtml: The OP-18 box is listed under Amazon's invite-based sale: you press the invite-request button on the product page, and Amazon later emails invitations to a subset of requesters. Requesting is free and does not commit you to buy. The step-by-step guide, including what gates overseas delivery, is on the Amazon Japan raffle page, where OP-18 is listed with a direct link.
An open invite request is not proof of delivery. Amazon opened requests before Bandai published the OP-18 page; the box ships only from the release date, November 21, 2026 in Japan.

sections.heading: What OP-17's launch showed
paragraphsHtml: OP-17 The World's Strongest Warriors released in Japan on August 22, 2026 and in English on August 28, 2026, the closest to a simultaneous global release the game has had. Its sealed Japanese box has been tracked from the first completed eBay sale, and that page shows the launch-week price path with sample counts.
One launch is one data point. Print volume, distribution, reprints and the card list all differ between sets, so OP-17's price path is context, not evidence of what OP-18 will do.

sections.heading: Evidence required before a sealed-box valuation
paragraphsHtml: A useful OP-18 valuation needs the official Japanese specification, the confirmed card list and treatments, language-matched completed sales with transaction counts, and a clear seal standard. Active listings show seller expectations and are not substituted for sales. Single-card prices do not translate into sealed-box value until pull rates and hit distribution are known.
Reprint information is reported only when Bandai, distributors, or dated market supply records support it. Absence of a reprint notice is not described as proof that no reprint will occur.

sections.heading: Update policy
paragraphsHtml: Bandai's product page is now published and its facts are recorded above. This page is reviewed again when the card list appears, when Bandai states a box configuration, and when a valid sold-box sample forms after release. Material changes receive a new visible review date. Price, population and reprint fields follow the definitions in our methodology; unavailable values remain unavailable.

faq: When does OP-18 release?
Bandai lists November 21, 2026 for the Japanese release and November 20, 2026 for English. Both official product pages were checked September 28, 2026.
What is OP-18 called?
The Japanese title is 神の支配 (Kami no Shihai); Bandai's English name is BOOSTER PACK -THE DOMINANCE OF GOD-.
Can I pre-order OP-18 now?

Amazon Japan is taking invite requests for the OP-18 booster box (24 packs). Requesting an invite is free; Amazon later invites a subset of requesters to buy, and boxes ship from the November 21 release. See the Amazon Japan raffle page for the steps.
Is there an English OP-18 release date?
Yes. Bandai's English product page lists November 20, 2026 — one day before the Japanese date — at USD $4.99 per pack.
What seal should a Japanese OP-18 box have?
Use the original uncut Bandai security tape as the primary factory-seal check. Added shrink is not a substitute.

pages.headline: EB-05 “Heroines Edition vol.2”: official product facts and data limits
pages.introHtml: EB-05 is the second Heroines Extra Booster. It releases on October 31, 2026 in Japan (ONE PIECE.com official news, September 25, 2026) and October 30, 2026 in English (Bandai's English Next Plan page). The Japanese pack is ¥240 with 6 cards and the English pack is USD $4.99 with 12 cards. Total card count, full card list and box configuration are not yet published.

pages.sourceHtml: Sources checked September 30, 2026: ONE PIECE.com official news of September 25, 2026 (Japanese date and price), Bandai's English Next Plan page (English date), and Bandai's Japanese and English EB-05 product pages (pack price and contents; release month only). Retailer listings are not treated as official confirmation.

sections.heading: Confirmed information and open fields
paragraphsHtml: Official sources establish the product name, the Japanese release date of October 31, 2026, the English release date of October 30, 2026, ¥240 and USD $4.99 per pack, and 6-card Japanese and 12-card English packs. Bandai also describes EB-05 as the second Heroines Extra Booster. None of the official pages checked provides a rarity breakdown, card-type total, card list or box configuration as of the review date.

Those gaps matter for sealed-box research. English pack contents cannot be copied into a Japanese display entry, and a box count shown by a shop is not a Bandai specification. OP Box Index therefore labels the dates and pack specifications above as confirmed and the remaining fields as pending.

sections.heading: What EB-03 can and cannot tell us
paragraphsHtml: EB-03 Heroines Edition is the closest thematic comparison because it is the first product in the same named line. Its live page contains the current sealed-box observations and chase-card data. Keeping that changing data on the EB-03 page avoids freezing an old price into this preview.

One predecessor is a sample of one. Differences in card list, print volume, distribution, release timing, and reprints can produce a different result for EB-05. EB-03's history is useful context, but it is not evidence that EB-05 demand or price will follow the same path.

sections.heading: Evidence required before a sealed-box valuation
paragraphsHtml: A useful EB-05 valuation needs the official Japanese and English specifications, confirmed card list and treatments, language-matched completed sales, transaction counts, and a clear seal condition. Active listings may show seller expectations, but they are not substituted for sales. Card prices also do not automatically equal sealed-box value because pull rates and hit distribution must be known.
Reprint information is reported only when Bandai, distributors, or dated market supply records support it. Absence of a reprint notice is not described as proof that no reprint will occur.

sections.heading: How to verify a Japanese sealed display
paragraphsHtml: For a Japanese One Piece display, require clear photos of the original Bandai security tape and confirm that it is uncut. Added shrink does not replace the tape check. Inspect the box code, top and bottom panels, side seams, dents, tears, and any adhesive irregularity. Loose packs, opened displays, mixed-language lots, and listings that conceal the tape are excluded.
The official English page describes packs, not a Japanese display seal. Product language and seal standard must therefore be recorded separately rather than inferred from the Heroines name.

sections.heading: Update policy
paragraphsHtml: This page will be reviewed when Bandai publishes additional specifications, the card list appears, or a valid sold-box sample forms. Material changes receive a new visible review date. Price, population, and reprint fields follow the definitions in our methodology; unavailable values remain unavailable.

faq: When does EB-05 release?

The Japanese release is October 31, 2026 and the English release is October 30, 2026. The Japanese date is from ONE PIECE.com official news (September 25, 2026) and the English date from Bandai's English Next Plan page. Checked September 30, 2026.
What is the official English pack price?
Bandai lists USD $4.99 per pack, with 12 cards in an English pack.
How many card types are in EB-05?
The official pages checked on September 30, 2026 did not list a total card-type count or full card list.
Does EB-03 predict EB-05's sealed-box price?
No. EB-03 is a relevant thematic comparison, but one predecessor cannot establish EB-05 demand, supply, or future price.
What seal should a Japanese EB-05 display have?
Use the original uncut Bandai security tape as the primary factory-seal check. Do not use added shrink as a substitute.
